info.name: Delta Labs API (Complete)
info.description:
Complete collection for **deltalabs-backend** (FastAPI).

### Collection variables
- `baseUrl` — e.g. `http://localhost:8000` (no trailing slash; default uvicorn)
- `access_token` — paste from `POST .../login` or `POST .../signup/complete` (requests add `Bearer `)
- `flow_id`, `verification_id`, `recover_id`, `reset_token`, `item_id`, `feature_key` — shortcuts for path/body

### Optional headers
- `X-Request-Id` — echoed on the response
- `Idempotency-Key` — enable on feed engagement POSTs for safe retries (echoed when sent)

### Auth
Protected routes need `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` (opaque string from login/signup responses).

### Errors
JSON envelope: `code`, `message`, `requestId`, `details`.

### Rate limits
`POST /v1/auth/*` may return **429** (`code: rate_limited`) per IP/minute; see env `RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_POSTS_PER_MINUTE`.

### Readiness
`GET /ready` returns **503** if MongoDB or Redis is unavailable.

### Config
If `API_V1_PREFIX` in `.env` is not `/v1`, update every `/v1/...` path (or add a `apiPrefix` variable). Default idempotency header name: `Idempotency-Key` (`IDEMPOTENCY_HEADER_NAME`).

### Tests scripts
Several requests run a **Tests** script that saves IDs/tokens to collection variables on 200.

request.description: 200 + `status: ready` if Mongo+Redis OK; 503 + `not_ready` + `checks` if not.
